timings.text: Managing complex college projects is hard. We fixed it with Project Track.
Experience seamless multi-role authentication for teachers and students.
Teachers can instantly create teams, assign subjects, and appoint group leads.
Students stay perfectly in sync with a zero-latency Kanban board.
Integrated chat and file sharing means you never have to leave your workflow.
Fully customizable with a beautiful dark mode. Project Track is the ultimate platform.
